correctness.rationale: Every length-n message has a heavy coordinate; S+2T<=qL and S<=q*2^(q-1) prove the global bound. Equality forces at most one omitted one-heavy word. Exact mixed-pair incidence proves the sharp parity thresholds. Complete-graph one-factors and Hamilton cycles produce matching constructions, while equality at L0 forces pair-supported additions and their independent count. All quantifiers and domain n>=q+1, q>=4 were checked against the stand-alone verifier and algebraic restrictions; numerical cases are corroboration only.
